gloss: to leave aside, to set aside, to ignore

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {差|さ}し{置|お}きませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {差|さ}し{置|お}いていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {差|さ}し{置|お}いていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to leave aside, to set aside, to ignore
definitions.explanation: To disregard someone or something, often giving priority to someone else or another matter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{差|さ}し{置|お}いて⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}めないで→進める：01949_susumeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't proceed with the discussion leaving me out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{差|さ}し{置|お}いて⟦{出世|しゅっせ}→出世：08359_shusse⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He got promoted ahead of his seniors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{差|さ}し{置|お}いて{勝手|かって}に⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{良|よ}くない→良い：02350_yoi⟧。
examples.english: It's not good to decide arbitrarily without consulting the person involved.

notes:
{差|さ}し{置|お}く means to bypass or ignore someone, often with negative connotations.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{差|さ}し{置|お}いて

COMMON PATTERNS:
- X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{差|さ}し{置|お}いて: leaving X aside, ignoring X
- ⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{差|さ}し{置|お}いて: without the person's involvement
- ⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{差|さ}し{置|お}いて: ahead of one's seniors

USAGE:
Often implies that someone was bypassed who should have been consulted or given priority.
